notes: Dusk 1.0.4 — Fixed per-pid inject + execute with real Roblox avatars (headshot endpoint corrected, initial-circle fallback when sidecar isn't published yet). + Three-source Script Hub picker: Scriptblox / Rscripts / Haxhell. + Toast notification system — inject button + attach + injected-as-<name> all pop toasts. + Every Roblox output line (print / warn / error / engine) streams through LogService.MessageOut into the Dusk console pane; no more 'mei mei' print, just a clean injected notification. + inj.exe now scans 8 ntdll exports for Hyperion's hook (works on builds that moved off NtCreateSection), waits up to 45s for Hyperion to lay its hook, FlushInstructionCache + 60ms settle before CreateRemoteThread. + RConsole shares the stub console instead of calling AllocConsole twice (fixed rconsoleprint-crashes-Roblox). + Credoxy 2c6fd5e0 offset fill: CallbackChain.HolderObject = 0x38, IdentityPtr = 0x84AED78, DataModel.GameLoaded = 0x5B8, new OpcodeDecodeTable + callback search fields. + Native print/warn left intact so sUNC's isexecutorclosure check passes. + Brand mark swapped to clean inline SVG D — no more pixelated icon. + Engine stability: zen_drain time-budgeted to 80ms per tick, extexecute byte-bounded (128MB total / 16MB per push), panic breaker rolled to 5-faults/3s/4s-hold.
